text: Sandpaper has a number called the grit. Small numbers are rough. Big numbers are smooth.
Start with 80 or 100 grit to remove marks. Then use 150. Finish with 220.
Sand along the grain, the same way the lines in the wood run.
Wrap the paper around a block to keep the surface flat.

tip.text: Wipe off the dust between grits so you can see what you missed.

text: Sanding makes dust. Wear your dust mask.
